title: Facebook Ads Vs Google Ads For Contractors - What's Better? | Lead Nurture Close Web Marketing

facts.fact: Per Ryan Goering of BaaDigi (2025), home services conversion rates average approximately 7.33% on Google Ads.
facts.quote: Conversion rates for home services average approximately 7.33% on Google Ads, compared to 9.21% on Facebook Ads.

facts.fact: Per Simply Be Found and Ryan Goering of BaaDigi (2025), Google Ads for home and home improvement businesses face an average cost per click of $7.85.
facts.quote: Google Ads for Home &Home Improvement businesses face an average cost per click of $7.85 and an average cost per lead of $90.92.

facts.fact: Per Simply Be Found and Ryan Goering of BaaDigi (2025), the average cost per lead for Facebook Lead Ads across all industries is $21.98.
facts.quote: For Facebook Lead Ads across all industries, the average cost per lead is $21.98

facts.fact: The vendor recommends allocating 30% of contractor ad budget to Facebook awareness ads for broad audience reach and brand introduction.
facts.quote: Allocate 30% for broad audience reach and brand introduction.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends allocating 50% of contractor ad budget to Google Display and Search consideration efforts for keyword-driven clicks and high-intent prospects.
facts.quote: Allocate 50% for capturing keyword-driven clicks and high-intent prospects.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends allocating 20% of contractor ad budget, shared across both platforms, to conversion retargeting to re-engage interested users.
facts.quote: Allocate 20% shared across both platforms to re-engage interested users.

facts.fact: The vendor reports that a residential plumbing client saw a 45% increase in emergency call volume from highly targeted Google Search Ads run by Lead Nurture Close.
facts.quote: A residential plumbing client experienced a remarkable 45% increase in emergency call volume through highly targeted Google Search Ads.

facts.fact: The vendor reports that an HVAC provider achieved a 30% boost in seasonal tune-up bookings from Facebook retargeting campaigns designed by Lead Nurture Close.
facts.quote: an HVAC provider achieved a significant 30% boost in seasonal tune-up bookings by leveraging Facebook retargeting campaigns
